Odeslal jsem ti dnes také rekomandovaný dopis. [Kdybys] sama pro nějakou příčinu při jetí [nemohla], prosím o [telegrafickou?] zprávu během soboty. Nesmírně se na [tebe; TOBE] těší a tisíc pus ti posílá tvůj Pepouš.
proposed_english_translation: Warm greetings, darling! I look forward to your waiting for me in [Veselá?] on Sunday, the 28th, by the morning express at 9 hours 40 minutes. I also sent you a registered letter today. [If you] [could not] travel for some reason, please send [a telegram?] during Saturday. Your Pepouš looks forward to seeing [you; TOBE] very much and sends you a thousand kisses.
